# Setup

```{r}

raw_data_cleaned <- readr::read_csv("data/cleaned/sept_14.csv") 

```
```{r}

used <- c("d_crim_abc", "d_incppl_pris_abc","d_incwomen_abc",
          "impact", "incarc", "knowincarc", "vict",
          "q15_1", "q15_2", "q15_3", "q15_4", "q15_5","dpen", "min_wage", "free_calls", "ed_funds", "alt_sentencing", "lwop",
"gov_attn", "vote2020", "willvote", "auto_reg", "post_felony_vote", "early_vote", "election_holiday", "voter_id", "noncit_local", "jail_access_rev", 
"white", "black", "native_am", "asian_am", "pac_island", "mena", "hisp_latino", "race_notlisted", "self_ideo", "fire_rare", "fire_privilege", "fire_angry", "fire_fear", "fiscal_ideology", "social_ideology", "Democrat", "Republican", "gender", "q58_1", "q58_2"

)

used_missing <- raw_data_cleaned %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(used),
      ~sum(is.na(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_answered = nrow(raw_data_cleaned)- n_missing,
    pct_missing = n_missing/nrow(raw_data_cleaned) * 100,
    pct_answered = n_answered/nrow(raw_data_cleaned) *100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

View(used_missing)

```

for overleaf

```{r}
used_var_missing_table <- used_var_missing %>%
    mutate(
    pct_missing = round(pct_missing, 1),
    pct_answered = round(pct_answered, 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Variable = variable,
    `N Missing` = n_missing,
    `N Answered` = n_answered,
    `% Missing` = pct_missing,
    `% Answered` = pct_answered
  )


used_var_missing_latex <- used_var_missing_table  %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    caption = "Missingness and Response Rates for Employed Survey Items",
    label = "tab:used_var_missingness",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    digits = 1
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header"),
    font_size = 9
  )

writeLines(
  used_var_missing_latex,
  "used_var_missing.tex"
)
```
